makemeahanzi.definition: to seek; to search for, to look for; ancient

characterDeckComponents.note: 彐 (a hand reaching out) — 寻 relates to searching, reaching for something.
寸 (cùn) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading xún has diverged.
灬 (fire) — 然 originally described burning; the meaning later shifted to 'so, correct' as 然 became a grammatical particle.
肰 (rán) gives the sound — 然 is also pronounced rán, an exact match.

meanings: noodles or pasta made from any kind of flour

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 (grain) — 粉 names a fine powder, originally made by grinding grain.
分 (fēn) gives a sound very close to fěn, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

meanings: to go out (of a fire etc)

etymology.hint: To cover 一 a flame 火

characterDeckComponents.note: 一 (a horizontal line) depicts something laid over the fire below.
火 (fire) — covering a flame to smother it gave 灭 its meaning 'to extinguish, to go out.'

meanings: to remove or dismiss from office

makemeahanzi.definition: to spare, to excuse from; to evade
to descend, to fall; to drop, to lower

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (hill) — 降 originally related to coming down a hill or slope
夅 (jiàng) gives the sound — an exact match with 降's reading jiàng

makemeahanzi.definition: to get, to obtain, to receive, to sieze

etymology.hint: A bird 隹 faced with a mountain 山

characterDeckComponents.note: 山 (mountain) sits on top.
隹 (a bird) sits below the mountain — the picture of a bird before a towering peak gave 崔 its original meaning 'high, lofty'; today it survives mainly as the surname Cui.
宀 (roof) — 富 relates to a well-stocked household, prosperous under its own roof
畐 (fú) gives a sound close to 富's reading fù, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to stand; to establish, to set up

etymology.hint: A man standing on the ground 一

characterDeckComponents.note: 立 depicts a person standing with arms and legs spread, on a horizontal line representing the ground — a simple picture of standing upright.
辶 (to walk/move) — 速 relates to the speed of movement
束 (shù) gives a loose sound connection to 速's reading sù

meanings: to lean forward, resting one's upper body

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 趴 relates to the position of the body, legs splayed.
八 (bā) gives a sound close to 趴's reading pā, sharing the final though the initial has shifted.

etymology.hint: An eye 巳 pierced by a dagger 戈, an old mark of slavery

characterDeckComponents.note: 巳 (here representing an eye) — in one traditional theory, this depicted a captive's marked eye, an ancient sign of subjugation, which later broadened to mean 'the common people.'
戈 (a dagger-axe) — combined with the eye shape above, this ties the character to the idea of marking or piercing.

makemeahanzi.definition: outstanding; to elevate, to lift, to raise

characterDeckComponents.note: 羽 (feathers/wings) — 翘 relates to something lifting upward, like a bird's tail feathers.
尧 (yáo) gives a sound distantly related to 翘's reading qiào, having drifted apart over time.
阝 (hill) — 险 originally referred to steep, dangerous terrain
佥 (qiān) gives a sound distantly related to 险's reading xiǎn, having drifted apart over time
穴 (hole/cave) — 窗 originally described an opening for light and air.
囱 (cōng) gives a sound distantly related to chuāng, having drifted apart over time.
亻 (person) — 伴 describes a person accompanying another.
半 (bàn) is an exact match for the sound of 伴.
瓦 is traditionally read as a picture of a curved, interlocking roof tile, seen in cross-section — the source of its meaning 'tile.'

makemeahanzi.definition: appearance, looks; form, figure; to contain, to hold

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof/house) — 容's meaning 'to contain, hold' relates to a house holding things, extended to 'appearance, to allow, tolerate.'
十 (ten, suggesting abundance) — relates to 华's meaning 'flowery, splendid,' an abundance of blossoms.
化 (huà) gives a sound hint — 华 is pronounced huá, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to apply; to erase, to smear, to wipe off

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 抹 describes an action done by hand, like wiping or smearing.
末 (mò) gives a sound close to mǒ, sharing the same initial and rhyme.
木 (tree/wood) — many early villages were built among or from trees and wood
寸 (cùn) gives a sound close to 村's reading cūn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: camp, barracks, army; to run, to manage
to think, to ponder, to consider; final particle

etymology.hint: Weighing something with your mind 囟 (altered) and heart 心

characterDeckComponents.note: An altered form of 囟 (the mind/head) — the seat of thought.
心 (heart) — thinking was pictured as an activity of both mind and heart, giving 思 its meaning 'to think.'

etymology.hint: A deer with an antlered head, two legs, and a tail

characterDeckComponents.note: 鹿 is a simplified picture of a deer, with its antlered head, long legs, and tail all visible in the strokes.

etymology.hint: A woman 女 holding a broom 十 in her hand 彐

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) sits at the base of the character.
彐-shaped strokes above picture a hand holding a broom, an old image of a wife managing the household.

etymology.hint: Water flowing 人 from a spring 口 through a valley 八

characterDeckComponents.note: 八-shaped strokes at the top picture the sloping walls of a valley.
口 below pictures a spring or opening where water flows out, giving 谷 its meaning 'valley.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to abandon, to discard, to reject; to desert; to forget

etymology.hint: Two hands 廾 discarding a dead, swaddled baby 亠厶

characterDeckComponents.note: 亠厶-shaped top pictures a bundled object being cast away.
廾 (two hands) below shows the act of throwing it out, giving 弃 its meaning 'to abandon, discard.'

meanings: (of a dam etc) to breach or burst

makemeahanzi.definition: to decide, to determine, to judge

characterDeckComponents.note: 介 (jiè) gives a sound hint — 价 is pronounced jià, sharing the same initial consonant though the vowel has shifted.
广 (a building/shelter) — 厅 names a large room inside a building, a hall.
丁 (dīng) gives a sound close to tīng.

etymology.hint: A person 㔾 being crushed under pressure 厂

characterDeckComponents.note: 厂 (a cliff or overhang) presses down from above.
㔾 depicts a crouching person — together showing someone pinned beneath a cliff, giving 厄's meaning 'hardship, adversity.'
艹 (plant) — 菲 describes a richly fragrant, luxuriant plant.
非 (fēi) gives the sound — an exact match with 菲.

makemeahanzi.definition: to survey, to measure; to estimate, to conjecture

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 测 originally referred to measuring the depth of water.
则 (zé) gives a rhyme close to cè, with the tone and initial shifted.

meanings: (following a decimal or fraction) slightly less than

etymology.hint: Two shoots 弓 dying to frost 冫

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 here pictures a young, bent shoot rather than a bow.
冫 (ice/frost) repeated twice suggests two young shoots wilting in the cold, giving 弱 its meaning 'weak, fragile.'

etymology.hint: A furry 毛 tail behind a body 尸

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸 (a body) — the body of an animal.
毛 (fur/hair) — trailing behind it, together giving 尾 its meaning 'tail.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to scour, to rub, to grind; friction

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 (hand) — 摩 describes rubbing something with the hand.
麻 (má) gives a sound distantly related to mó, having drifted apart over time.
氵 (water) — 液 names any liquid or fluid.
夜 (yè) gives the sound — an exact match with 液.

makemeahanzi.definition: to direct; to squander; to wave; to wipe away

etymology.hint: To direct an army 军 by hand 扌

characterDeckComponents.note: 军 (army) — an army being directed
扌 (hand) — the hand giving the command or wave
纟 (thread) — 终 originally referred to the end of a woven thread, extended to mean 'end, final'
冬 (dōng) gives a loose sound connection to 终's reading zhōng

etymology.hint: The logical order 仑 of human 亻 society; 仑 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 伦 relates to human relationships and social order.
仑 depicts an orderly, logical arrangement — combined with 亻, giving 伦 its meaning 'human relationships, order.'

etymology.hint: A tongue 千 sticking out of a mouth 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 千 here pictures a tongue sticking upward.
口 (mouth) sits below it — together, a tongue sticking out of a mouth, giving 舌 its meaning.
月 (moon) — 朗 describes the moon's bright, clear light.
良 (liáng) gives a rhyme close to lǎng, with a different initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: to defy, to fight, to resist

etymology.hint: Fighting 亢 with bare hands 扌; 亢 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — fighting back with bare hands
亢 — the throat, a vulnerable point defended while resisting

etymology.hint: A leader 尹 giving orders 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 尹 depicts a hand holding a staff of authority, a leader.
口 (mouth) — a leader giving spoken orders gave 君 its meaning 'ruler, monarch.'

meanings: used in 嚕囌|噜苏[lu1 su1]

makemeahanzi.definition: to awaken, to revive, to resurrect; used in transliterations

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass/plant) — 苏 relates to certain aromatic plants and to reviving, coming back to life
稣 (sū) gives the sound — 苏 is also pronounced sū, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to sink, to submerge; profound, deep

etymology.hint: An excessive 冗 amount of water 氵

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — the water something sinks into
冗 (excess/heavy) — the excess weight that pulls it down

etymology.hint: The plots of a rice paddy

characterDeckComponents.note: A bird's-eye view of a plot of farmland divided into four smaller squares.

meanings: to pull (an animal on a tether)

makemeahanzi.definition: to drag, to pull, to lead by the hand

etymology.hint: A person 大 pulling an ox 牛 by a rope 冖

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (a person) at the top represents someone leading.
冖 (a rope or cover shape) in the middle shows a tether.
牛 (ox) at the bottom is the animal being led, giving 牵 its meaning 'to lead by hand, to pull.'

meanings: (bound form) kidney of an animal (as food)
the waist of trousers or a skirt

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — 腰 names the waist, a part of the body.
要 (yào) gives a sound very close to yāo, sharing the rhyme — only the tone differs.
